reason: Provides mobile browser access to a desktop DSH Web UI over a local network with password-gated sessions and real-time synchronization, but the README documents a public default password, HTTP credential transmission, and potentially unauthenticated API endpoints.

summaries.zh: 通过局域网让手机或平板以密码访问 DSH Web UI，并与电脑端实时同步会话及输入输出。
summaries.en: Enables password-based access to the DSH Web UI from phones or tablets on a local network with real-time session and input/output synchronization.

capabilities: Exposes a web UI to devices on the local network
Authenticates browser sessions with a configured password and cookie token
Enables real-time synchronization between mobile clients and the desktop web UI
May leave API endpoints callable without authentication according to the README
Transmits the access password over HTTP when used as documented
